timingScope: Absolute QPC edges: frame start, prepare end, bind end, clear end, composite end, copy end, blocking Map end, Unmap end, frame end. Interior edges are zero when timers are off. Controls omit clear and/or composition; preparation, binding and one-pixel completion remain.
schedulingScope: Per-window main/process cumulative counters are sampled outside frames. QPC edges permit external ETW alignment; no scheduler-delay, GPU-duration or dedicated-host attribution.
captureValidationScope: PNG structure, CRC, bounded chunks, IHDR 1280x720, IDAT and final IEND only; decoding and populated-scene visual proof belong to the native capture gate.
benchmarkInputsScope: benchmarkInputs/benchmarkSha256 retain the canonical ComplexUi closure; profilingInputs binds this diagnostic fixture, shared helpers, dispatcher and runner.
measurement: Diagnostic only. Fixed extra warmup and sampling are not canonical acceptance; no regression, trusted-policy, actual scheduling, heap-owner or dedicated-host verdict.
